Bangladesh vs Sri Lanka LIVE Score, SAFF Championship: BAN 1 - 0 SL; Shome gives Bengal Tigers the lead in first half
 BAN vs SL LIVE: Catch the score, updates and highlights from the SAFF Championship Group A encounter between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka in Dhaka on Wednesday.

 W elcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the SAFF Championship Group A encounter between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
 Bangladesh has already secured a place in the semifinal of the tournament with a 1-0 win over Bhutan. Sri Lanka, which drew 2-2 against the same opponent, will need a point to seal second place. 
 Match overview: 
 Venue: National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh
 Kick-off time: 8:00 pm local time (7:30 pm IST)
 Key Updates
 8' Shome scores!
 November 11, 2026 19:56 
 25'
 Chance!! Hamza almost backflicks the ball into the net! A diagonal into the right is headed back to the middle by Farhan and the keeper comes for it and misses.
 Hamza tries to flick it with his back to goal but it flies just over.
 November 11, 2026 19:52 
 21'
 Tomason is down on the pitch for Sri Lanka. The medical staff has been called to tend to him. 
 Tomason is unable to continue and will be replaced on the pitch by Suresh. 
 November 11, 2026 19:49 
 19'
 A tackle from behind by Hossain as he tries to help defensively on the right flank. He is lucky not to see yellow. Set-piece chance for SL.
 Rajamohan puts it deep into the box, bounces off the defender’s head and goes out for a corner. The corner is safely handled by the keeper. 
 November 11, 2026 19:45 
 15'
 Hamza marshalling his troops vocally. He isn’t happy with the closing down in the middle of the pitch. The Tigers haven’t created anything since opening the scoring. 
 Another dangerous ball in by Hossain. Perera once again fails to get a hand to it but the defender was there to kick it away from goal. 
 Hamza with a shot from the edge of the box following a corner, just wide off the right-hand post. 
 November 11, 2026 19:43 
 13'
 De Silva drops his shoulders on the right wing and manages to put a cross in, too high and it bounces out of play. 
 November 11, 2026 19:41 
 11' 
 Rajamohan with a chance for SL. Wriggled himself free off the central defender but was closed down by Shome before he could get a shot away. 
 November 11, 2026 19:38 GOAL 
 8' Shome scores!
 GOAL!! Again, it’s a cross from the right that troubles the Lions’ defence. The keeper came for it but couldn’t collect it cleanly, the first shot was blocked but Shamit Shome was there to turn the rebound into the net.
 BAN 1 - 0 SL 
 November 11, 2026 19:38 
 7'
 Dangerous ball into the box from Hossain. Farhan fails to bring it under control in the box and therefore can’t get the shot away. 
 The second ball is held by the keeper.
 November 11, 2026 19:35 
 4'
 Bangladesh very much on the ascendancy. A free kick at the edge of the box for skipper Hamza Choudhury.
 Five-member wall in place. Hamza shoots it over the post, attempted to bend it around the wall. 
 November 11, 2026 19:32 
 Kick off!
 Bangladesh gets us underway in its red and white kits. Sri Lanka in full blue. 
 An early foray into the box but Hossain fouls the defender in the box.
 November 11, 2026 19:18 
 A 1-0 win for India earlier today
 India beats Maldives to book SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal spot
 India booked its place in the SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal after beating Maldives 1-0 at the National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh on Wednesday.
 November 11, 2026 19:08 
 Bangladesh Playing XI
 Mehedi Sarabon (GK), Zayyan Ahmed, Saad Uddin, Zidane Yousuf, Tariq Kazi, Shamit Shome, Hamza Choudhury (C), Quazem Shah, Farhaan Ali Wahid, Rakib Hossain, Mohammad Ibrahim
 November 11, 2026 19:05 
 Sri Lanka Playing XI
 Sujan Perera (GK), Garrett Kelly, Dillon de Silva, Samuel Durrant, Leon Perera (C), Steven Sakayaradjy, Claudio Kammerknecht, Niloshan Senthurwasan, William Thomason, Adhavan Rajmohan, Jason Thayaparan
 November 11, 2026 19:00 
 Group A standings ahead of final game
 SAFF Group A.png
 November 11, 2026 18:50 
 Semifinal spot on the line
 Sri Lanka is still in contention for a spot in the final four. But a loss at the hands of the host will put it level with Bhutan on goal difference. 
 November 11, 2026 18:34 
 Good evening!
 Hello and welcome to the live coverage of the SAFF Championship contest between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.
 One final match to look forward too in the group stage before the final four teams are set for knockout football.
